name: Scales
description: See any scale on a piano and a guitar neck, with the notes, degrees and steps, and hear it going up and down.
prompt: A music scales reference with every root and major, minor, pentatonic, blues, harmonic minor, modes and chromatic scales, showing the notes, degrees and whole and half steps, on a two-octave piano or a 15-fret guitar neck you can tap, and playing it up and down.
author: gonzaroman

description_i18n.es: Mira cualquier escala en un piano y en el mástil de una guitarra, con las notas, grados e intervalos, y escúchala subir y bajar.
